executive_summary.narrative_summary: ComplianceAI addresses the regulatory compliance infrastructure gap for AI in financial services. Banks are deploying AI models faster than they can prove compliance to regulators.
executive_summary.opportunity_snapshot: Regulatory pressure on AI increasing (Federal Reserve, SEC, OCC guidance 2023-2024). $2.5B TAM. Market window urgent.
executive_summary.customer_snapshot: Primary segment: Chief Compliance Officers at Top 100 US banks. 150 addressable customers. Willingness-to-pay: $150-500K annually.
executive_summary.business_model_snapshot: SaaS subscription model. Year 1 target: 12 customers, $3M revenue. Break-even month 14. Base scenario recommended.
